description: Latest hourly nitrogen dioxide (NO2) reading in ug/m3 at the nearest working Defra AURN monitor, with its Daily Air Quality Index band (1-10, Low to Very High) and health advice. NO2 is mainly traffic and diesel pollution, the UK's headline roadside pollutant, so this answers "how bad is the traffic pollution near me right now" for cyclists, parents on the school run and people with asthma. Source: Defra UK-AIR. A single monitor can be several km away and not represent your street. (cost: 1 credit)

lat.description: number, required, latitude of the place (UK, 49 to 61)

lon.description: number, required, longitude of the place (UK, -9 to 2.5)

max_km.description: number, optional, furthest monitor to use in km, default 25, max 100

name: no2_level_near
